changelog.en: New company policies: DisableInstall = 1 turns the store into a read-only catalog, DisableSelfUpdate = 1 hides the store's own update (for IT-managed rollouts of the MSI). Both under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Kofax\PDF\Tungsten Power PDF\PluginStore\Policies\Store.

complianceAudit.method: Checked all #include directives and linker inputs of PluginStore.vcxproj (Windows SDK, MFC/ATL, Tungsten Power PDF Plugin SDK only), the bundled UILayout and icon files (own work, icons drawn by client/res/make_icons.py) and the package contents. One third-party component: the Microsoft WebView2 SDK static loader (BSD-3-Clause), linked into PluginStore.zxt; its NOTICE lists only BSD-licensed .NET tooling that is not used. The bundled MSI is built with the WiX Toolset v3 (build tool; its standard WixUI dialog resources are part of the installer). No credentials, personal data or third-party trademarks in the package. The only network service is the configured Add-on Store server (HTTPS). The MSI also installs AddonStoreLink.exe (own code, no network access), which handles addonstore:// links by passing a validated package id to the client.

externalServices.name: Add-on Store server (configurable; default addon.power-pdf.de, Azure address ppdf-store.azurewebsites.net)
externalServices.data: Catalog and package downloads; sends the Power PDF UI language and the beta channel flag, no personal data.
